name: Beehive Loop
why: Iron rungs and ladders straight up a granite cliff above Sand Beach, then down past the Bowl, a pond in the woods.
book: Vehicle reservation for Cadillac Summit Road only; the Island Explorer bus stops at Sand Beach.
dangers: Exposed iron rungs on a 140 m cliff: not for anyone afraid of heights or small children.
Do not come down the rungs: take the Bowl Trail.

points.name: Beehive trailhead
points.note: On Park Loop Road across from the Sand Beach parking.

points.name: The Beehive
points.note: A dome of pink granite over Sand Beach and the Atlantic.

points.name: The Bowl
points.note: A quiet pond in the woods behind the Beehive.
